events.title: 2026 Iran War / Strait of Hormuz Crisis
events.summary: Active war between US/Israel coalition and Iran + Axis of Resistance (Hezbollah, Houthis, PMF). Strait of Hormuz effectively closed. IEA calls it largest oil supply disruption in history. Brent crude at 82.37, up 32.91pct YoY.
sources: Wikipedia: Economic impact of 2026 Iran war

events.title: 2026 Ebola Epidemic - WHO PHEIC
events.summary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in DRC and Uganda. WHO declared PHEIC on May 16. 4748 confirmed cases, 2216 deaths (46.7pct CFR). Second-largest Ebola outbreak ever. No approved vaccine for BDBV. Spreading in 6 DRC provinces + Kampala, Uganda. Armed conflict (M23) hinders response.

notable_observations: US Fed: Rate at 3.50-3.75pct, markets pricing 30pct chance of hike. No emergency action.
ECB: Set to deliver final rate hike next month per Reuters. Not emergency.
Japan: Joint US-Japan yen intervention on Jul 31 (first since 1998). BOJ at 1.00pct, government supports near-term hike.
China: PBOC pledging timely new policy rollout (Reuters Aug 12). Yuan strengthening.
LatAm: Argentina central bank reform vote Aug 19. Country risk at 451bps.
EM Asia: Won nears 1400 with sharpest swings since financial crisis. Joint intervention helping.
Financial System: No acute bank failure detected. Fed modernizing insider lending rules.
Commodities: Oil surging on Hormuz. Gold at 4432 (safe haven). Food index at 131.17.
